summary.text: Jack Chance is a Democrat running for the open Indiana House of Representatives District 30 seat in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Paula Davis.
He works in property management and affordable housing and lives in Kokomo.

paragraphs.text: Jack Chance graduated from Tipton High School, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as property management.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Indianapolis, raised in Tipton, and now lives in Kokomo.
He described earlier jobs at Taco Bell and KFC, managing a receiving dock at a retail store, and helping homeowners with insurance disputes, before his current work in affordable housing.
Chance advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
He listed affordable health care, publicly funded education, and a requirement that businesses receiving tax breaks hire local Hoosiers among his key messages.
He also said he supports raising the minimum pay guarantee for teachers to $75,000 per year.
